exclusions.source_text: Age ≥16 years during dose escalation portion of study, patients must weigh ≥40 kg.
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status must be 0, 1, or 2; Karnofsky ≥50 for patients ≥16 years of age; and Lansky ≥50 for patients ≥12 to 16 years of age.
Cardiac LVEF of ≥40%, as measured by echocardiogram or MUGA scan
AST(SGOT)/ALT(SGPT) ≤5 × institutional ULN and total bilirubin ≤ 2x institutional ULN unless related to leukemic involvement or known Gilbert's syndrome (for bilirubin).
Patients with concurrent malignancy who are receiving chemotherapy or whose disease is uncontrolled or progressing are not eligible.
Active central nervous system (CNS) involvement by AML (i.e., CNS-2 or CNS-3 disease).
symptomatic congestive heart failure (NYHA class 3 or higher)
Mean corrected QT interval corrected for heart rate by Frederica's formula (QTcF)>480ms.
Patients of childbearing potential are eligible for the study but must comply with the pregnancy prevention plan for study drugs.
